contraindications.t: Co-administration with drugs highly dependent on CYP3A4 (e.g. simvastatin, ergometrine, midazolam oral)

cautions.t: Very many interactions – check each co-prescription
Rifampicin needs dose adjustment (double dose) per guideline

adverse_effects.t: Diarrhoea, nausea, dyslipidaemia, insulin resistance, hepatitis, QT/PR prolongation
